evaluates the organization’s decision.

practice_questions.adaptation_rationale: Retains request/response reasoning as web-server function and client-server roles; HTML rendering details are not claimed as a requirement.
practice_questions.solution: The browser acts as client and sends a request to the museum’s web server. The server hosts the resource, processes the request and returns the page data. The client then presents the response to the user; the server can serve many separate client requests.

marking_points.criterion: Response returned for client presentation/multiple clients served.
